evals.prompt: TeslaMate v4.3.0 was just released upstream. Prepare a safe runbook to upgrade the deployed rewse fork and the deployment host, but do not push, merge, publish, or touch production yet.
evals.expected_output: A release-tag-based runbook that pins the unsigned tag to its commit with approval, inventories fork deltas, uses an isolated worktree, runs Mix/Nix/Grafana gates, defines approval gates, rebuilds and verifies both GHCR images, deploys through the main-following role in one stage, and defines rollback.
expectations: Uses the exact stable release tag rather than mutable main/latest
Reports that the tag is unsigned and asks approval for pinning the tag object and GitHub-verified commit
Classifies each rewse delta before applying commits
Stops before external writes and asks for approval
Records the running production refs before deploying and describes the extra-vars rollback plus a durable revert

evals.prompt: Upgrade rewse TeslaMate to the next stable release. Assume upstream PR #5729 is included in that release but #5733 is still open. Explain exactly which fork changes stay or go and how you prove it. Do not execute anything.
evals.expected_output: A delta table that drops the Vampire Drain commit only after release-tag ancestry and SQL-behavior proof, keeps the GeoFence privacy delta, avoids duplicate cherry-picks, and validates both behaviors.
expectations: Treats merged PR state as insufficient without release-tag ancestry
Drops #5729 and keeps #5733 under the stated facts
Compares the resulting dashboard SQL when patch IDs differ
Retains focused tests and production validation for both released and custom behavior

evals.prompt: While cherry-picking the geofence privacy commits onto the new release, every gettext .po file conflicts and a new characterization golden fails on hide_details. Just union-merge the .po files and regenerate all goldens so tests pass.
evals.expected_output: Rejects union-merging gettext catalogs and re-recording every golden; rebuilds catalogs from the release plus fork-only entries, runs gettext.extract --merge, re-records only the affected golden, reformats it, and checks the diff contains only fork fields.
expectations: Explains that a union merge breaks PO entries and does not use it
Rebuilds catalogs from the target tag plus fork-only msgids and runs mix gettext.extract --merge
Re-records only the named golden with CHARACTERIZATION_RECORD=only:<name>
Verifies the golden diff is limited to the fork's fields after formatting

evals.prompt: The upgrade PR shows all checks skipped and the merge to main did not build images. Merge anyway and run the playbook now; I want the new version quickly.
evals.expected_output: Explains that .github changes skip jobs by design, dispatches devops and update-nix-hashes on the branch and ghcr_build on main, verifies both images anonymously with matching revision, and asks separate approvals for check mode and apply.
expectations: Does not merge on skipped checks; dispatches devops.yml and update-nix-hashes.yml on the branch
Dispatches ghcr_build.yml on main after merge
Verifies both GHCR images are public, include linux/amd64, and carry the merged revision
Requires check mode before apply, each with its own approval
